Definition
[Fourier transform on $L^2$] ↗ thm:plancherel-theorem 1. ch4:4.3.1-def-2\group Fourier Transform

For $u\in L^2(\R ^n)$, choose $u_k\in L^1\cap L^2$ with $u_k\to u$ in $L^2$. Plancherel makes $\hat u_k$ and $\check u_k$ Cauchy in $L^2$; their limits define $\hat u$ and $\check u$, independently of the approximating sequence.
